# category: # This file is the only record of how each profile reaches each tool.
#   direct       = port 18888, the direct tool calling mode
#   programmatic = port 8888, the programmatic tool calling mode
#   reason       = why an mcp tool script cannot call the tool. Required on a row whose programmatic is x, and left out on every other row:
#                    no_structured_content  answers with content such as an image or text instead of structured content
#                    astah_api_script       runs an astah api script
#                    network                may fetch over the network or convert a PDF
#                    project_file           creates, opens or saves a project
#                    standalone             answers a standalone question about the project, the Astah view, the MCP server or the logs
#                    background_job         starts work in a separate process in the background, or waits for its result
#                    direct                 published directly for none of the reasons above
# Every profile column takes one of these values, which mean the same in each:
#   x  published as an MCP tool
#   s  not published, but called from an mcp tool script (run_mcp_tool_script)
# A row with direct = x has programmatic = x or s, so that whatever the direct profile publishes, the programmatic profile reaches too.
# The tools below are deliberately reached by no profile at all.
# ER: the editing tools are withheld because there are too many of them and publishing them may affect the existing tools
